name: apple-calendar-mcp
description: Look up events in selected Apple calendars on this Mac using three read-only tools.

interface.shortDescription: Look up events and free time
interface.longDescription: Read events from Apple Calendar on this Mac. Provides exactly three read-only tools: list_calendars, read_events, and search_events. Choose allowed calendars before reading events. Returns titles, start/end times, calendar names and an all-day indicator; never accesses notes or attendees. No create, update or delete tools. Uses local stdio without a public network port. Defaults to Asia/Hong_Kong and queries at most 31 days per call. Free time is inferred from selected calendars only. Requires macOS Calendar Full Access, with read-only behavior enforced by the implementation. Calendar results enter the conversation. Mac availability and account synchronization affect freshness.
defaultPrompt: Show tomorrow's events in my selected Apple calendars, using Hong Kong time.
Find my team meetings in my selected Apple calendars this month.
Use my selected Apple calendars to suggest free time next week.
